title: scala-cli hello world
description: Adds a scala-cli entry point pinned to the chosen Scala release, a matching .scalafmt.conf, the README with a mise setup recipe, and the .gitignore for Scala tooling, OS junk, environment files, mise.local.toml and Claude Code local settings. Expr segments on the commit_* answers end .gitignore with a stanza for the tooling kept out of git, plus paseo.json and .weft/, and leave the mise recipe out when mise.toml is kept out too.

content.expr:
'' if commit_skills and commit_mcp and commit_mise and commit_instructions else '

# Local tooling, kept out of git
' + '
'.join([p for p, kept_out in [('/.agents/', not commit_skills), ('/.claude/skills/', not commit_skills), ('/.mcp.json', not commit_mcp), ('/.codex/', not commit_mcp), ('/.omp/', not commit_mcp), ('/mise.toml', not commit_mise), ('/AGENTS.md', not commit_instructions), ('/CLAUDE.md', not commit_instructions), ('/paseo.json', True), ('/.weft/', True)] if kept_out])

hooks.label: Verify the correct Scala version is installed
Verify correct version of `scalafmt` is installed
Commit the scaffold
hooks.description: First commit after every setup hook that may exist has run.
